selection_reasoning: I selected 'find chiseled_red_sandstone' as the single atomic task. This is a straightforward observation/navigation task where the agent must locate a chiseled red sandstone block placed in the scene. It requires no deep Minecraft crafting knowledge — just visual recognition and navigation. The block has a distinctive texture (hieroglyphic-like pattern on red sandstone) making it identifiable. As a single task, no multi-hop dependencies are needed, but it still requires the agent to explore the environment and correctly identify the block among potential distractors.

milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. The player must navigate close to the chiseled red sandstone block at spawn-relative (4, 1, 4) and face toward it. max_distance=4 ensures the player has actually walked toward the target pillar (which is ~5.7 blocks from spawn), requiring intentional navigation rather than accidental facing from spawn. facing_tolerance=45 ensures the player is looking directly at the block and not at a nearby distractor pillar.

scene_description: A flat desert area with 6 two-block sandstone pillars arranged around the player spawn. One pillar (at ~4, ~1, ~4) has chiseled red sandstone on top — the target block with a distinctive Wither pattern. The other 5 pillars use visually similar but distinct sandstone variants as distractors: smooth red sandstone, cut red sandstone, chiseled sandstone (regular/yellow), and plain red sandstone. The player must navigate the scene, visually distinguish the chiseled red sandstone from the distractors, and approach it.
task_text: Find the chiseled red sandstone block among the sandstone pillars in this desert area. It has a distinctive Wither-like hieroglyphic pattern on a red/orange background. Walk to it and look at it.
design_notes: Layout: 6 pillars at eye level (y=0 base, y=1 top) on a sand platform. Target chiseled red sandstone is at (~4,~1,~4) — approximately 5.7 blocks from spawn in the southeast direction. Distractors placed at various positions around spawn (NW, NE, SW, SE quadrants) to require exploration. Sand fill extends 3 blocks deep (y=-3 to y=-1) to prevent terrain gaps. Air fill clears any natural blocks above the platform. All pillars are within 7 blocks of spawn, ensuring the scene is explorable within the step limit.
